Prioritize actionable security defects in pull requests; omit style-only findings.
Check authorization, session boundaries, untrusted input, injection, secret exposure and dependency risk.
For signing and financial code, check message/account binding, replay protection, exact accounting and durable recovery.
Respect existing protocol compatibility and never suggest logging keys or private user state.
For each finding, identify the affected line, realistic exploit condition and smallest safe fix.
Do not claim a security review proves the absence of vulnerabilities.
